tools.name: find_profiles
tools.description: Search public logr profiles by name, handle, bio, or location. Returns handles to use with the other tools.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: A profile's identity card: who they are, what they're doing now, socials, and timeline stats.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: A profile's timeline events, newest first, optionally filtered by tag, year, featured, or pinned.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One timeline event in full, including its media (image/video/link URLs).

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Keyword search over a profile's timeline (title, body, tags). All terms must match. Plain text matching — no semantic search.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: The complete Markdown context for a profile — identity, about, and full timeline with sources. Same content as the logr://profiles/{username} resource, for clients that prefer tools.
